title: So much fun!
text: Excellent and fun way to see Barcelona! Pablo was a great guide, knowledgeable and fun. Highly recommend!
author: Jeanne_D

title: Best tuk tuk  in Barcelona
text: It was a fabulous way to see the city of Barcelona. We had a fabulous tour guide. He knew so much about the city. We are very blessed to have him showing us around..
author: Coleen_F

title: Fun in the heat
text: There was plenty of room for four oof us. A great way to be introduced to Barcelona. Our guide covered a lot of area and allowed stops for photo ops. It was an extremely hot day, being open and coveted , we were very comfortable. It was fun.
author: margaret_d

title: Take the TukTul!
text: Frederico with walktuktuk tour was amazing! We saw everything we wanted to in a very iunique open air vehicle. It definitely helped with the heat as we had a nice breeze!
author: danmS3407HI

title: Must book. Great experience.
text:
Our driver was amazing. Full of information and went the extra mile to show us secret spots for great photos.
Definitely worth booking.
author: Christina_H

title: Tour Barcelona.
text: Very nice outing with sights around Gaudi and Barcelona. Definitely a good choice to quickly see something of the city and get an explanation.
author: VWHolic

title: Great tour!
text: We did a 2 hour tour on June 5th with Walk Tuk. Pick up was very near placa catalunya. It was a great overview of barcelona especially for first time visitors. The driver was a good tour guide with lots of helpful info. It’s not the cushiest of seats, but we did fine. Well done.
author: tartan

title: Great way to see...
text: Great way to see Barcelona on a short time frame! Our tour guide was very knowledgeable, told us all about each monument we saw; highly recommend!
author: Katerina_L

title: Great experience
text: My friend and I loved this tuk tuk tour. Frederico was full of knowledge and delivered the facts with a relaxed air making it a really fun experience.
author: Emma_C

title: Great tour and exceptional driver!
text: Fredrick was absolutely wonderful and extremely knowledgeable about the history of the entire route. What a great yep hours. Best driver we have had.
author: Donald_M
